questions.hint: Judge the exact spot the plant will live in, not the room's best hour.

options.label: Gloomy
options.description: North-facing, or a good stretch from the window

options.label: Decent
options.description: A bright room, but no direct sun on the spot

options.label: Sun-drenched
options.description: Direct sun on the sill for a few hours a day

questions.hint: Be honest — the plants already know.

options.label: Forgetful
options.description: Weeks can slip by; the watering can gathers dust

options.label: Steady
options.description: A reliable round with the can most weekends

options.label: Devoted
options.description: Misting, moisture checks, leaf-wiping — the full spa

questions.hint: Cats, dogs, rabbits — anyone who treats houseplants as salad.

options.label: Pets about
options.description: Only show plants that are safe to nibble

options.label: No pets
options.description: The whole bench is fair game

care.attentive: Repays the fussing — misting and all

light.brighter: Honestly wants more light than you've got — give it your brightest spot and expect slower growth
light.dimmer: Prefers softer light than a blazing sill — set it a step back from the glass

care.more: Wants steadier watering than you're promising — a phone reminder would save it
care.less: Easy to love to death — water it half as often as you're tempted to
